facts.sentence: Rebecca Lynn Foster received a preferred rating.

facts.name: Policy Owner Identity
facts.sentence: The owner of the policy is Rebecca Lynn Foster.

facts.name: Death Benefit Amount
facts.sentence: The death benefit under the policy is $340,000.

facts.name: 20-year policy term
facts.sentence: The policy term lasts for 20 years.

facts.name: Policy Termination Date
facts.sentence: The policy ends on April 10, 2046.

facts.name: Annual Premium Amount
facts.sentence: The annual premium for the policy is $1,960.

facts.name: Annual Premium Payment
facts.sentence: The premium payment mode is annual.

facts.name: Return of Premium Amount
facts.sentence: The guaranteed end-of-term return of premium amount is $39,200.

facts.name: Inflation Credit Feature
facts.sentence: The policy includes an inflation credit feature.

facts.name: Annual Policy Mode
facts.sentence: The policy mode is annual.

facts.name: Guaranteed ROP Amount
facts.sentence: The guaranteed end-of-term return of premium (ROP) amount is $39,200.

facts.name: Inflation Credit Feature
facts.sentence: This policy includes an inflation credit feature.

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: The primary beneficiary is Nathaniel Scott Foster.

facts.name: Spouse Beneficiary Designation
facts.sentence: Nathaniel Scott Foster is designated as the spouse of the insured.

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary Allocation
facts.sentence: Nathaniel Scott Foster's share of the primary beneficiary designation is 100%.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiaries
facts.sentence: The contingent beneficiaries are Ella Jane Foster and Mason Luke Foster.

facts.name: Equal Contingent Beneficiary Shares
facts.sentence: Ella Jane Foster and Mason Luke Foster each receive equal shares as contingent beneficiaries.

facts.name: Return of Premium Term Policy
facts.sentence: This policy is a Return of Premium Term Life policy.

facts.name: Inflation Credit Feature
facts.sentence: This policy includes an inflation credit feature.

facts.name: Return of Premium Guarantee
facts.sentence: If the insured survives the policy term, and all required base premiums are paid, 100% of paid base premiums will be refunded.

facts.name: Non-Guaranteed Inflation Credit
facts.sentence: This policy may pay a separate non-guaranteed inflation credit.

facts.name: Inflation Credit Conditional Payment
facts.sentence: The inflation credit is only payable if declared by the insurer.

facts.name: Death Benefit Payout Amount
facts.sentence: If the insured dies during the policy term while the policy is in force, the death benefit payout is $340,000.

facts.name: Death Benefit Payout
facts.sentence: The death benefit is payable to the named beneficiary.

facts.name: Inflation Credit Not Payable on Death
facts.sentence: The non-guaranteed inflation credit is not payable upon the death of the insured.

facts.name: Document Submission Requirement
facts.sentence: Claimants must provide documents that are reasonably required by the insurer.

facts.name: Survival Requirement for ROP Payout
facts.sentence: The policyholder must be alive on April 10, 2046.

facts.name: Policy In Force Condition
facts.sentence: This policy must be in force on April 10, 2046.

facts.name: Survival Payout Condition
facts.sentence: If both conditions in the previous two facts are met, $39,200 will be paid.

facts.name: Additional End-of-Term Amount
facts.sentence: At the end of the term, an additional amount may be declared.

facts.name: Cap on Inflation Credit
facts.sentence: The additional amount at the end of the term cannot exceed 15% of the guaranteed Return of Premium (ROP).

facts.name: Inflation-Based Additional Payment
facts.sentence: The additional amount reflects cumulative inflation experience.

facts.name: Inflation Adjustment Formula
facts.sentence: The additional amount is determined using the insurer's administrative formula.

facts.name: Early Surrender Value: Years 1–5
facts.sentence: For years 1 through 5, the Early Surrender Value is 0%.

facts.name: Early Surrender Value: Years 6–10
facts.sentence: For years 6 through 10, the Early Surrender Value is 30%.

facts.name: Early Surrender Value: Years 11–15
facts.sentence: For years 11 through 15, the Early Surrender Value is 60%.

facts.name: Early Surrender Value: 90%
facts.sentence: For years 16 through 19, the Early Surrender Value is 90%.

facts.name: Year 20 Surrender Value
facts.sentence: For year 20, the Early Surrender Value is 100%.

facts.name: Early Surrender Payout Limitation
facts.sentence: On surrender before the end of the term, only the vested guaranteed ROP is payable.

facts.name: No Inflation Credit on Surrender
facts.sentence: No inflation credit is payable upon surrender before the end of the term.

facts.name: Annual Premium Amount
facts.sentence: The annual premium is $1,960.

facts.name: Annual Premium Due Date
facts.sentence: The annual premium is due each April 10.

facts.name: Level Premiums Throughout Term
facts.sentence: Premiums remain level throughout the policy term.

facts.name: Grace Period Duration
facts.sentence: The grace period for premium payment is 31 days.

facts.name: Late Payment Penalty on Inflation Credit
facts.sentence: A premium paid more than 10 days late results in the reduction of any non-guaranteed inflation credit for that policy year to zero.

facts.name: Late Payment & Guaranteed ROP Protection
facts.sentence: A late premium payment does not reduce the guaranteed ROP if paid within the grace period.

facts.name: Conversion Eligibility Window
facts.sentence: Conversion is available before the earlier of policy year 15 or age 65.

facts.name: Conversion ROP Forfeiture
facts.sentence: Guaranteed rate of return on any converted portion is forfeited unless credited by the permanent form then offered.

facts.name: Inflation Credit Loss on Conversion
facts.sentence: No inflation credit survives conversion.

facts.name: Reference CPI Determination
facts.sentence: We determine the reference Consumer Price Index for this policy form.

facts.name: Administrative Method Determination
facts.sentence: We determine the administrative calculation method for this policy form.

facts.name: Non-Guaranteed Inflation Credit
facts.sentence: The inflation credit is non-guaranteed.

facts.name: Inflation Credit May Be Zero
facts.sentence: The inflation credit may be zero.

facts.name: Uniform Admin Method Application
facts.sentence: Administrative method changes will apply on a uniform basis.

facts.name: Protection of Declared Inflation Credits
facts.sentence: Administrative method changes will not reduce any inflation credit already declared.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Clause
facts.sentence: If the insured dies by suicide within 24 months from issue, liability is limited to return of premiums paid for the base policy.

facts.name: Contestability Period
facts.sentence: We may contest the policy within two years from issue for material misrepresentation.

facts.name: No Inflation Credit on Death Termination
facts.sentence: No inflation credit is payable if the policy terminates by death.

facts.name: No Inflation Credit on Surrender
facts.sentence: No inflation credit is payable if the policy terminates by surrender.

facts.name: Lapse Terminates Inflation Credit
facts.sentence: No inflation credit is payable if the policy terminates by lapse before end of term.

facts.name: Reinstatement Eligibility Window
facts.sentence: Reinstatement is available within five years after lapse if the insured is living.

facts.name: Evidence of Insurability Requirement
facts.sentence: Reinstatement requires evidence of insurability satisfactory to Sterling Prairie Life Assurance.

facts.name: Reinstatement Interest Requirement
facts.sentence: Reinstatement requires payment of overdue premiums with five percent annual interest.

facts.name: No Inflation Credit During Lapse
facts.sentence: No inflation credit accrues for any lapsed period.

facts.name: Owner Beneficiary Change Right
facts.sentence: The owner may change beneficiaries.

facts.name: Owner Surrender Right
facts.sentence: The owner may surrender the policy.

facts.name: Owner Policy Conversion Right
facts.sentence: The owner may convert the policy.

facts.name: Beneficiary Change Procedure
facts.sentence: Any request to change beneficiaries must be made in writing.

facts.name: Surrender Request Format
facts.sentence: Any request to surrender the policy must be made in writing.

facts.name: Conversion Request Requirements
facts.sentence: Any request to convert the policy must be made in writing.

facts.name: Beneficiary Change Procedure
facts.sentence: Any request to change beneficiaries must be made by approved electronic method.

facts.name: Policy Surrender Method
facts.sentence: Any request to surrender the policy must be made by approved electronic method.

facts.name: Policy Conversion Request Method
facts.sentence: Any request to convert the policy must be made by approved electronic method.

facts.name: No Loan Value
facts.sentence: This policy has no loan value.

facts.name: Age Misstatement Adjustment
facts.sentence: Misstatement of age adjusts insurance to the amount purchasable by the premium paid.

facts.name: Misstatement Adjustment Rule
facts.sentence: Misstatement of sex adjusts insurance to the amount purchasable by the premium paid.

facts.name: Tax Advisor Consultation Required
facts.sentence: A tax advisor should be consulted regarding premium refunds.

facts.name: Tax Advice on Inflation Credit
facts.sentence: A tax advisor should be consulted regarding any non-guaranteed inflation credit.

facts.name: Policyholder Service Availability
facts.sentence: Sterling Prairie Life Assurance provides policyholder service.

facts.name: Contact Information
facts.sentence: The phone number for Policyholder Service is 1-866-STERLING.

facts.name: Contact Email Address
facts.sentence: The email address for Policyholder Service is service@sterlingprairielife.com.

facts.name: Policy Execution Location
facts.sentence: The policy was executed at Omaha, Nebraska.

facts.name: Policy Execution by Vice President
facts.sentence: The Vice President of Sterling Prairie Life Assurance signed the policy.

facts.name: Execution Date
facts.sentence: The date of execution is April 10, 2026.

facts.sentence: The annual premium for this policy is $1,980.

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary Designated

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiaries

facts.name: Son of Insured
facts.sentence: Liam Daniel Whitmore is the son of the insured.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Share
facts.sentence: Ava Claire Whitmore is entitled to 50% of the contingent beneficiary share.

facts.name: Level Death Benefit
facts.sentence: This policy provides a level death benefit for 20 years.

facts.name: Staged Vesting Feature
facts.sentence: This policy includes staged vesting of return-of-premium value.

facts.name: Conversion Option to Permanent Insurance
facts.sentence: This policy includes a conversion option to permanent insurance.

facts.name: Loyalty Bonus Incentive
facts.sentence: This policy offers a loyalty bonus equal to 2% of returned premiums.

facts.name: Loyalty Bonus Condition
facts.sentence: The loyalty bonus applies only if no premium has been paid after the due date during the entire term.

facts.name: Rider Charges Excluded
facts.sentence: Rider charges are not included in the return-of-premium amount.

facts.name: Rider Fees Excluded from ROP
facts.sentence: Policy fees for optional riders are not included in the return-of-premium amount.

facts.name: Excluded Reinstatement Charges
facts.sentence: Reinstatement charges are not included in the return-of-premium amount.

facts.name: Death Benefit Amount
facts.sentence: If the insured dies during the term while this policy is in force, the death benefit payable is $35.

facts.name: Death Benefit Payout
facts.sentence: If the insured dies during the term while this policy is in force, the insurer will pay $350,000 to the beneficiary.

facts.name: Claim Documentation Requirement
facts.sentence: The beneficiary must submit a certified death certificate when filing a claim.

facts.name: Claim Documentation Requirement
facts.sentence: The beneficiary must submit a completed claim statement when filing a claim.

facts.name: Claim Documentation Requirement
facts.sentence: The beneficiary must submit proof of identity when filing a claim.

facts.name: Claim Documentation Requirement
facts.sentence: The beneficiary must submit any assignment documentation that is currently on record when filing a claim.

facts.name: End-of-Term ROP Payout
facts.sentence: If the insured is alive on April 10, 2046 and the policy has remained continuously in force, the insurer will pay $39,600.

facts.name: Survival Bonus Payout Condition
facts.sentence: If the insured is alive on April 10, 2046 and the policy has remained continuously in force, the insurer will pay any applicable loyalty bonus under Section 1.3.

facts.name: Early Surrender ROP: Years 1–4
facts.sentence: For policy years 1 through 4, 0% of base premiums are returned upon early surrender.

facts.name: Early Surrender ROP: Years 5–8
facts.sentence: For policy years 5 through 8, 25% of base premiums are returned upon early surrender.

facts.name: Early Surrender Return Rate: Years 9–12
facts.sentence: For policy years 9 through 12, 50% of base premiums are returned upon early surrender.

facts.name: Early Surrender ROP: 75%
facts.sentence: For policy years 13 through 16, 75% of base premiums are returned upon early surrender.

facts.name: Early Surrender Return Rate (Years 17–19)
facts.sentence: For policy years 17 through 19, 90% of base premiums are returned upon early surrender.

facts.name: Early Surrender: Year 20 Return
facts.sentence: For policy year 20, 100% of base premiums are returned upon early surrender.

facts.name: Surrender Request Effective Date
facts.sentence: A surrender request becomes effective on the date it is received at the insurer's home office.

facts.name: Policy Surrender Termination Time
facts.sentence: Coverage terminates at 12:01 a.m. on the next policy day after a surrender request is processed.

facts.name: ROP Payment Timeline
facts.sentence: ROP payments are made within 45 days after the insurer receives all documents reasonably required to process the payment.

facts.name: Annual Premium Due Date
facts.sentence: An annual premium of $1,980 is due each April 10.

facts.name: Level Premiums Throughout Policy Term
facts.sentence: Premiums are level for the full duration of the policy term.

facts.name: Grace Period Payment Effect
facts.sentence: A premium paid during the 31-day grace period maintains the policy’s active status.

facts.name: Grace Period Payment Exclusion
facts.sentence: A premium paid during the 31-day grace period does not qualify the policy year for loyalty bonus credit.

facts.name: Policy Lapse After Grace Period
facts.sentence: If a premium remains unpaid beyond the 31-day grace period, the policy lapses.

facts.name: Lapse Triggers ROP Forfeiture
facts.sentence: Upon policy lapse, the vested ROP value is forfeited.

facts.name: ROP Forfeiture on Lapse
facts.sentence: The vested ROP value is forfeited upon policy lapse unless the policy is reinstated under Section 8.

facts.name: Rider Waived Premiums Excluded
facts.sentence: Premiums waived under a separate rider do not count as paid for the purpose of calculating returned premiums.

facts.name: Rider Waiver Payment Status
facts.sentence: Premiums waived under a separate rider count as paid only if the rider expressly states otherwise.

facts.name: Conversion Without Medical Proof
facts.sentence: This policy may be converted to an eligible permanent life insurance policy without providing evidence of insurability.

facts.name: Conversion Time Limits
facts.sentence: Conversion is available before the earlier of: the end of policy year 15, or the insured's 65th birthday.

facts.name: Minimum Conversion Amount
facts.sentence: The minimum conversion amount is $100,000.

facts.name: Maximum Conversion Amount Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum conversion amount is equal to the face amount then in force.

facts.name: Term Coverage Ends on Full Conversion
facts.sentence: Upon conversion of the entire policy, term coverage ends.

facts.name: No End-of-Term ROP on Full Conversion
facts.sentence: Upon conversion of the entire policy, no end-of-term ROP will be payable.

facts.name: Premium Credit Eligibility Condition
facts.sentence: Vested surrender value may be applied as a premium credit only if the permanent form then offered allows such credit.

facts.name: Return-of-Premium Credit
facts.sentence: The permanent form offers permits such credit.

facts.name: Accidental Death Benefit Rider Availability
facts.sentence: Optional riders available at issue include the Accidental Death Benefit Rider.

facts.name: Children's Term Rider Availability
facts.sentence: Optional riders available at issue include the Children's Term Rider.

facts.name: Waiver of Premium Rider Availability
facts.sentence: Optional riders available at issue include the Waiver of Premium Rider.

facts.name: Rider Premium Separation
facts.sentence: Rider premiums are separate from the base policy premium.

facts.name: Rider Premium Exclusion
facts.sentence: Rider premiums are not included in the return-of-premium calculation.

facts.name: Rider Termination Independence
facts.sentence: Termination of a rider does not terminate the base policy.

facts.name: Suicide Limitation Clause
facts.sentence: If the insured dies by suicide within 24 months from issue, liability is limited to the premiums paid for the base policy.

facts.name: Suicide Liability Limitation
facts.sentence: If the insured dies by suicide within 24 months from issue, liability is reduced by any indebtedness.

facts.name: Suicide Liability Reduction
facts.sentence: If the insured dies by suicide within 24 months from issue, liability is reduced by any rider benefits previously paid.

facts.name: Contestability Period
facts.sentence: This policy may be contested during the first two years for material misrepresentation in the application.

facts.name: No War Exclusion on Base Benefit
facts.sentence: No war exclusion applies to the base death benefit.

facts.name: Aviation Exclusion Absence
facts.sentence: No aviation exclusion applies to the base death benefit.

facts.name: Policy Reinstatement Window
facts.sentence: A lapsed policy may be reinstated within 3 years after lapse.

facts.name: Policy Reinstatement Requirement
facts.sentence: Reinstatement of a lapsed policy requires that the insured is living.

facts.name: Reinstatement Evidence Requirement
facts.sentence: Reinstatement of a lapsed policy requires receipt of evidence of insurability satisfactory to the insurer.

facts.name: Policy Reinstatement Requirements
facts.sentence: Reinstatement of a lapsed policy requires payment of all overdue premiums with interest at 5% per year.

facts.name: Reinstatement of ROP Benefits
facts.sentence: After reinstatement, prior vested ROP percentages resume.

facts.name: Loyalty Bonus Loss Upon Lapse
facts.sentence: No loyalty bonus is available for any policy year in which lapse occurred.

facts.name: Loyalty Bonus Loss Post-Lapse
facts.sentence: No loyalty bonus is available for any policy year subsequent to a lapse.

facts.name: Overdue Premium Interest
facts.sentence: Overdue premiums are paid with interest at 5% per year.

facts.name: Reinstated ROP Restoration
facts.sentence: After reinstatement, prior vested ROP percentages resume.

facts.name: Loyalty Bonus Loss Due to Lapse
facts.sentence: No loyalty bonus is available for any policy year in which lapse occurred.

facts.name: Loyalty Bonus Forfeiture Post-Reinstatement
facts.sentence: No loyalty bonus is available for any later reinstated year.

facts.name: New Suicide Period Scope
facts.sentence: A new suicide period applies only with respect to statements made in the reinstatement application.

facts.name: New Contestability Period Scope
facts.sentence: A new contestability period applies only with respect to statements made in the reinstatement application.

facts.name: Owner Beneficiary Changes
facts.sentence: The owner may change beneficiaries.

facts.name: Owner Assignment Right
facts.sentence: The owner may assign the policy.

facts.name: Owner May Surrender Policy
facts.sentence: The owner may surrender the policy.

facts.name: Owner May Elect Conversion
facts.sentence: The owner may elect conversion.

facts.name: Ownership Transfer Right
facts.sentence: The owner may transfer ownership by written notice acceptable to HarborStone Mutual Life Insurance Company.

facts.name: Ownership Change Effective Upon Recording
facts.sentence: Any ownership change takes effect when recorded by HarborStone Mutual Life Insurance Company.

facts.name: Ownership Change Conditions
facts.sentence: Any ownership change is subject to any action taken before recording.

facts.name: Misstatement of Age Adjustment
facts.sentence: If there is a misstatement of age, benefits will be adjusted to the amount the premium would have purchased at the correct age.

facts.name: Misstatement of Sex Adjustment
facts.sentence: If there is a misstatement of sex, benefits will be adjusted to the amount the premium would have purchased at the correct sex.

facts.name: No Cash Loan Value
facts.sentence: This policy has no cash loan value.

facts.name: Tax Implications of Returned Premiums
facts.sentence: Returned premiums may have tax consequences depending on applicable law.

facts.name: Tax Implications of Returned Premiums
facts.sentence: Policyholders should consult a qualified tax advisor regarding returned premiums.

facts.name: Customer Service Availability

facts.sentence: Anthony James Carter is designated as spouse.

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary Share
facts.sentence: Anthony James Carter's share of the primary beneficiary designation is 100%.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiaries
facts.sentence: The contingent beneficiaries are any surviving children of the insured.

facts.name: Contingent Beneficiary Shares
facts.sentence: The contingent beneficiaries receive equal shares.

facts.name: Return of Premium Policy
facts.sentence: This policy is a Return of Premium Term Life policy.

facts.name: Family Income Replacement Purpose
facts.sentence: The purpose of this policy is family income replacement.

facts.name: Premium Recovery Purpose
facts.sentence: The purpose of this policy includes premium recovery at the end of the term.

facts.name: Premium Refund Guarantee
facts.sentence: If the insured survives the entire term and all modal premiums are paid, 100% of paid base premiums will be refunded.

facts.name: Immediate Death Benefit
facts.sentence: If the insured dies during the term, a lump sum death benefit will be paid immediately.

facts.name: Lump Sum Death Benefit Amount
facts.sentence: The lump sum death benefit amount is $200,000.

facts.name: Monthly Benefit Start Timing
facts.sentence: If the insured dies during the term, a monthly family income benefit begins on the first monthly anniversary after death.

facts.name: Monthly Family Income Benefit
facts.sentence: The monthly family income benefit amount is $2,500.

facts.name: Continuing Family Income Benefit
facts.sentence: The monthly family income benefit continues for the remaining months of the term.

facts.name: Personal Income Replacement Purpose
facts.sentence: This policy is intended for personal income replacement.

facts.name: Not for Business Continuation
facts.sentence: This policy is not issued for business continuation purposes.

facts.name: Immediate Death Benefit Payout
facts.sentence: The policy pays $200,000 immediately to the beneficiary while the policy is in force.

facts.name: Monthly Death Benefit Start
facts.sentence: Beginning on the first monthly anniversary after death, the policy pays $2,500 per month.

facts.name: Monthly Payment Termination Conditions
facts.sentence: Monthly payments under section 2.2 continue until the earlier of: the end of the original policy term, or exhaustion of 240 monthly payments from policy issue.

facts.name: Lump Sum Election Option
facts.sentence: The beneficiary may elect a discounted commuted lump sum instead of monthly payments.

facts.name: Lump Sum Election Window
facts.sentence: The election for a discounted commuted lump sum must be made within 60 days after claim approval.

facts.name: Claim Documentation Requirements
facts.sentence: Proof required for claims includes standard death claim documents.

facts.name: Claim Documentation Requirements
facts.sentence: Proof required for claims includes payment election forms.

facts.name: Survival-based premium return
facts.sentence: If the insured is alive on April 10, 2046, and the policy has not terminated by death, the owner receives a return of premiums.

facts.name: Maximum Return Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum amount returned under Section 3.1 is $42,720.

facts.name: No Return in Early Years
facts.sentence: For policy years 1 through 7, there is no return of premiums.

facts.name: Return of Premium: Years 8–12
facts.sentence: For policy years 8 through 12, 40% of premiums paid are returned.

facts.name: Return of Premiums: 70%
facts.sentence: For policy years 13 through 17, 70% of premiums paid are returned.

facts.name: Surrender Value: Years 18–19
facts.sentence: For policy years 18 through 19, 85% of premiums paid are returned.

facts.name: Policy Year 20 Refund
facts.sentence: For policy year 20, 100% of premiums paid are returned.

facts.name: No Separate ROP with Death Claim
facts.sentence: If death occurs, no separate Return of Premium (ROP) is added to the family income claim.

facts.name: Automatic Draft Discounts Included
facts.sentence: Any premium discounts granted for automatic draft are included in the total premiums paid.

facts.name: Refund Eligibility Based on Actual Payments
facts.sentence: Only the actual premium amount paid is eligible for refund.

facts.name: Monthly Premium Due Date
facts.sentence: Premiums are due monthly on the 10th day of each month.

facts.name: Grace Period Duration
facts.sentence: A 31-day grace period applies after each due date.

facts.name: Late Payment Penalty on ROP
facts.sentence: If three or more monthly premiums are paid after the due date during the policy term, the end-of-term ROP is reduced by 5%.

facts.name: Automatic Draft Failure Responsibility
facts.sentence: If automatic draft fails, the owner remains responsible for timely payment regardless of whether notice is received.

facts.name: Conversion Without Evidence
facts.sentence: This policy may be converted to a permanent policy before the end of policy year 12 without evidence of insurability.

facts.name: Conversion Ends Income Feature
facts.sentence: Upon conversion, the monthly family income feature ends unless the new form expressly includes a comparable option.

facts.name: Benefit Reduction Request
facts.sentence: On written request after policy year 10, the owner may reduce the monthly family income benefit.

facts.name: Premium Reduction After Year 10
facts.sentence: On written request after policy year 10, the owner may proportionally reduce the premium when reducing the monthly family income benefit.

facts.name: Premium Reduction & ROP Adjustment
facts.sentence: Any reduction in premium proportionally reduces the maximum ROP.

facts.name: Optional Riders List
facts.sentence: Optional riders include Children's Term.

facts.name: Optional Riders Include Accidental Death
facts.sentence: Optional riders include Accidental Death.

facts.name: Waiver of Premium Rider
facts.sentence: Optional riders include Waiver of Premium for Disability.

facts.name: Rider Charges Non-Refundable
facts.sentence: Rider charges are not refundable under the ROP feature.

facts.name: Premium Mode Change Impact
facts.sentence: Changing premium mode may change total refundable premiums.

facts.name: Suicide Death Refund Clause
facts.sentence: Death by suicide occurring within 24 months from issue results in a refund of base premiums paid.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Clause
facts.sentence: Death by suicide occurring within 24 months from issue terminates coverage.

facts.name: Contestability Period
facts.sentence: Statements in the application may be contested for material misrepresentation up to two years after issue.

facts.name: Family Income Benefit Termination
facts.sentence: The family income feature is not payable for any month after the end of the policy term.

facts.name: Policy Reinstatement Window
facts.sentence: A lapsed policy may be reinstated within 4 years after lapse.

facts.name: Policy Reinstatement Requirement
facts.sentence: Reinstatement of a lapsed policy requires evidence of insurability.

facts.name: Policy Reinstatement Requirements
facts.sentence: Reinstatement of a lapsed policy requires payment of overdue premiums.

facts.name: Reinstatement Interest Requirement
facts.sentence: Reinstatement of a lapsed policy requires 6% annual interest on overdue amounts.

facts.name: Reinstatement Benefit Delay
facts.sentence: The commuted lump-sum option is unavailable for 12 months after reinstatement.

facts.name: Owner Beneficiary Change Right
facts.sentence: The owner may change beneficiaries.

facts.name: Policy Assignment Right
facts.sentence: The owner may assign the policy.

facts.name: Policy Surrender Right
facts.sentence: The owner may surrender the policy.

facts.name: Owner Commuted Payout Right
facts.sentence: The owner may request a commuted payout election after death.

facts.name: Owner Payment Mode Change
facts.sentence: The owner may change the payment mode.

facts.name: Policy Change Requirements
facts.sentence: Changes to the policy must be made in a form acceptable to the insurer.

facts.name: No Loan Value Policy
facts.sentence: This policy has no loan value.

facts.name: Age Misstatement Adjustment
facts.sentence: Misstatement of age will adjust benefits to what the premium would have purchased at the correct age.

facts.name: Sex Misstatement Adjustment
facts.sentence: Misstatement of sex will adjust benefits to what the premium would have purchased at the correct sex.

facts.name: Non-guaranteed tax treatment
facts.sentence: Tax treatment of returned premiums is not guaranteed by CedarBridge Assurance Company.

facts.name: Tax Treatment Uncertainty
facts.sentence: Tax treatment of family income payments is not guaranteed by CedarBridge Assurance Company.

facts.name: Customer Service Availability
facts.sentence: CedarBridge Assurance Company provides customer service.

facts.name: Customer Service Contact Info
facts.sentence: Contact for questions or service is available via phone at 1-877-CEDAR-LIFE.

facts.name: Contact Information
facts.sentence: Contact for questions or service is available via email at support@cedarbridgeassurance.com.

facts.name: Policy Execution Location
facts.sentence: The policy was executed at Des Moines, Iowa.

facts.name: Policy Signed by President
facts.sentence: The President of CedarBridge Assurance Company signed the policy.

facts.name: Execution Date
facts.sentence: The date of execution is April 10, 2026.

facts.name: Mortgage Refinancing & Assignment Continuity
facts.sentence: Refinancing of the mortgage does not automatically terminate any assignment related to this policy.

facts.name: Not Lender-Issued Insurance
facts.sentence: This policy is not lender-issued mortgage insurance.

facts.name: Suicide Death Refund Clause
facts.sentence: If the insured dies by suicide within 24 months from issue date, the insurer will refund premiums paid for the base policy.

facts.name: Contestability Period
facts.sentence: The insurer may contest this policy within two years from issue for material misrepresentations.

facts.name: Suicide Refund Clause
facts.sentence: If the insured dies by suicide within 24 months from issue, the insurer will refund premiums paid for the base policy.

facts.name: Contestability Clause
facts.sentence: The insurer may contest this policy within two years from issue for material misrepresentation.

facts.name: No Occupational Exclusion
facts.sentence: No occupational exclusion applies to this policy.

facts.name: No Travel Exclusion
facts.sentence: No travel exclusion applies to this policy.

facts.name: No Residential Exclusion
facts.sentence: No residential property exclusion applies to this policy.

facts.name: Policy Reinstatement Window
facts.sentence: Reinstatement is available within 5 years after lapse.

facts.name: Reinstatement Evidence Requirement
facts.sentence: Reinstatement requires satisfactory evidence of insurability.

facts.name: Reinstatement Interest Requirement
facts.sentence: Reinstatement requires payment of arrears with 5.5% interest.

facts.name: Prior Assignment Continuity
facts.sentence: Any prior assignment remains in effect unless released.

facts.name: Owner Beneficiary Change Right
facts.sentence: The owner may change beneficiaries.

facts.name: Owner Assignment Right
facts.sentence: The owner may assign collateral.

facts.name: Owner can release collateral
facts.sentence: The owner may release collateral.

facts.name: Owner Surrender Right
facts.sentence: The owner may surrender the policy.

facts.name: Owner's Partial Conversion Right
facts.sentence: The owner may elect partial conversion.

facts.name: Owner Request Requirement
facts.sentence: Any request regarding owner rights must be in writing.

facts.name: Owner Request Formality
facts.sentence: Any request regarding owner rights must be in a form acceptable to the insurer.

facts.name: Age Misstatement Adjustment
facts.sentence: Misstatement of age adjusts benefits to the amount the premium would have purchased at the correct age.

facts.name: No Loan Value
facts.sentence: This policy has no loan value.

facts.name: No Partial Withdrawal Feature
facts.sentence: This policy has no partial withdrawal feature.

facts.name: Tax Treatment of Premiums vs Benefits
facts.sentence: Returned premiums may be treated differently from death benefits for tax purposes.

facts.name: Tax Treatment of Returned Premiums
facts.sentence: Policyholders should consult a tax advisor regarding tax treatment of returned premiums.

facts.name: Tax Implications of Death Benefits
facts.sentence: Death benefits may have implications for tax purposes.

facts.name: Consult Tax Advisor on Death Benefits
facts.sentence: Individuals should consult a tax advisor regarding death benefits for tax purposes.

facts.name: Customer Service Provision
facts.sentence: NorthPeak Life & Guaranty provides customer service.

facts.name: Customer Service Contact Info
facts.sentence: The NorthPeak Life & Guaranty customer service phone number is 1-866-NORTHPK.

facts.name: Customer Service Email
facts.sentence: The NorthPeak Life & Guaranty customer service email address is service@northpeaklife.com.

facts.name: Document Execution Location
facts.sentence: This document was executed in Denver, Colorado.

facts.name: Vice President Signed Document
facts.sentence: The Vice President of NorthPeak Life & Guaranty signed this document.

facts.name: Execution Date
facts.sentence: The date of execution of this document is April 10, 2026.
